description: This file defines an abstract PHPUnit test base class 'KernelTestCase' for the OrangeHRM project, setting up test environment, dependencies, and helper services related to the framework's kernel and service container.

classes.name: KernelTestCase
classes.description: An abstract base test class for setting up application kernel and service dependencies in tests for the OrangeHRM framework.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Clears the EntityManager and recreates the kernel after each test.

methods.name: getHttpRequest
methods.description: Creates and returns a new HTTP Request object with provided parameters.

methods.name: createKernel
methods.description: Initializes a mocked Framework kernel, resets container services, and sets core services, returning the mock Framework instance.

methods.name: createKernelWithMockServices
methods.description: Sets up the kernel with additional mock services injected into the container.

methods.name: updateOptions
methods.description: Replaces the default options with provided options.

methods.name: setHelperServices
methods.description: Initializes and injects helper service mocks into the container if enabled.

methods.name: setBaseServices
methods.description: Initializes and injects core services like ProjectService and CandidateService into the container if enabled.
